# I turned 24 founders into MCP servers you can plug into Claude (open source)

Hey indiehackers! How's it going? :)

Long time no see haha. I've been building something I'm really excited about, and it's finally live.

It's called The Brains: 

The idea is simple. Take the smartest founders on earth, pull everything they've said in talks, essays and posts, and turn each one into an MCP server. You add it to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex and just ask it stuff. Every answer cites the exact source, so it's not AI making things up.

There are 24 brains right now: Naval, Pieter Levels, Marc Lou, Alex Hormozi, Rob Walling, Justin Welsh and more.

I launched it 2 days ago with zero marketing and people are already using it way more than I expected: [...] Naval is the most popular so far, then Hormozi and Marc Lou. Watching the questions come in is honestly the best part. People asking Hormozi how to trim their offer stack, asking Blake Anderson how he priced his apps, etc.

It's 100% free and open source (MIT), so you can run your own or add a brain: 

Who should I clone next? Drop a name in the comments and I'll build the top ones 👇

Cheers,  
Vic
